summary: Running work and streaming thinking use a shared S1 Lucide loader-circle spinner: one compositor-only turn per second, a static frame under reduced motion, and off-screen pause based on fixed boxes rather than rotating glyphs. Waiting for an answer uses a clock; the composer send arrow is unchanged. The exploration play combines invariant checks and yields between shells to avoid assertion-log churn and long synchronous layout probes, preserving all checks and negative controls.

compatibility.detail: No persisted compatibility change. Kit consumers compose composition/Spinner directly instead of Icon's removed spinner glyph and spinning flag; names, roles and status labels are unchanged.
